exposure: Percutaneous radiofrequency ablation (PRFA) of anterior abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) lesions
outcome: Clinical symptoms (nodule pain at palpation, cyclic pain visual analogic scale, noncyclic pain)
cohort: Ten patients with 1 to 3 anterior abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) lesions were treated with percutaneous radiofrequency ablation.
finding: Percutaneous radiofrequency ablation (PRFA) was found to be 100% feasible and clinically effective for treating anterior abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE), demonstrating significant reductions in pain and lesion volume, and improved quality of life at 6 months.
